0xs4n4tg-kinetograph-cli-kinetograph.description: Make videos and motion graphics with Kinetograph. Write Remotion-shaped TSX (useCurrentFrame, interpolate, spring, Sequence, native elements) and Web Audio code, or an HTML page with GSAP (HyperFrames projects render as they are), look at frames with `kinetograph still` and `strip`, check them with `inspect` and `lint`, then `render` to MP4. Use when asked to build, edit, preview or render a video, animation, title card or sound design with Kinetograph.

0xs4n4tg-kinetograph-cli-kinetograph-mig.description: Move an existing Remotion project onto Kinetograph so it renders without a browser. Use when the user has a Remotion project (remotion or @remotion/* imports, `remotion render` scripts, @remotion/three, @remotion/player) and wants it to run, preview or render with Kinetograph, or asks what in a Remotion project will not work there.
